gloss: the streets, the public, the world at large

definitions.gloss: the streets, the public, the world at large
definitions.explanation: The general public sphere or everyday world. Used to refer to what is being talked about, what is popular, or what is happening among ordinary people.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}で{話題|わだい}になっている。
examples.english: It is the talk of the town.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}には{様々|さまざま}な{噂|うわさ}が{飛|と}び{交|か}っている。
examples.english: Various rumors are flying around in the streets.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}で{流行|りゅうこう}している{健康|けんこう}{法|ほう}がテレビでも{取|と}り{上|あ}げられ、さらに{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: A health method popular among the public was also featured on TV, drawing even more attention.

notes:
USAGE:
{巷|ちまた} is a somewhat literary or journalistic word referring to the general public sphere. It is often used to introduce what people are talking about or what is trending. Common patterns include {巷|ちまた}では (in the public sphere, among people) and {巷|ちまた}で{話題|わだい}の (the talk of the town). While it literally means streets or crossroads, it is rarely used in a purely geographical sense in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巷|ちまた}で{話題|わだい}の: the talk of the town
- {巷|ちまた}に{溢|あふ}れる: to be all over the streets
- {巷|ちまた}の{声|こえ}: the voice of the people
- {巷|ちまた}で{流行|りゅうこう}る: to be popular among people
